full_judgment: 8. In the background and facts of the case, it has been seen that successive criminal cases are being instituted against the accused-petitioner and when bail is granted in a particular case he is not allowed to be released because in the meantime he is shown arrested in other cases instituted subsequently or beforehand and in such a manner the order granting bail cannot be made effective. From the statement it appears that the petitioner was arrested at midnight in between 24th and 25th April by breaking open the doors entering into his bed room. He was granted bail by the Magistrate but his release was stopped by the police as he was shown arrested in another Badda PS case on the same day and in that Badda PS case No. 57(4)03 the petitioner was granted bail on 26 April, 2003 and when he was about to be released on furnishing bail bond his release was stopped saying that yet there is another case i.e. Badda PS Case No. 47(5)02, and he was shown arrested in that case. In this way bail granting order was not allowed to be made effective because in the meantime the petitioner was shown arrested on the prayer of the prosecution. Badda PS Case No. 27(3)04 was initiated on 20-3-2004 under section 10(1)(2) of the Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 which is pending in the Court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Dhaka. It appears from the lower Court record that on 23-3-2004 on the basis of a report and the cause shown therein the investigating officer made a prayer on 23-3-2004 for showing the accused-petitioner arrested in Badda PS Case No. 6(9)2003 under section 143/148/447/302/34 Penal Code stating that he is in jail custody since 21-3-2004 and also made a prayer for sending the accused-petitioner on remand for the sake of investigation and the petitioner prayed for bail. After hearing application for bail it was kept in the record and the case was fixed on 25-3-2004 for hearing on remand in presence of the accused petitioner but the remand order could not have been made as in the meantime the case record was sent for by this Court.
